notes: V3 DAG L3 #53 — author two tightly-paired dual-stack schema packages: pheno-zod-schemas (TypeScript + Zod) and pheno-pydantic-models (Python + Pydantic v2). Both packages mirror the same 3-entity domain model (User, WorklogEntry, Project) and the same 5 test cases, so any drift between the TS and Python wire contracts will be caught at PR review time.

pheno-zod-schemas: ESM package @kooshapari/pheno-zod-schemas (per task brief, name preserved). exports './src/index.ts'. tsconfig: strict:true, target:ES2022, module:NodeNext, moduleResolution:NodeNext. deps: zod ^3.23, typescript ^5.4, vitest ^1.6. Three Zod schemas: UserSchema, WorklogEntrySchema, ProjectSchema. WorklogStatus is exported as a `as const` tuple of 6 members (pending, running, blocked, completed, failed, cancelled) and a derived WorklogStatusType. Each schema has both a runtime Zod value and an inferred TypeScript type via `z.infer<typeof XSchema>`. The ProjectSchema's 'owner must be a member' invariant is enforced via `.refine`, mirroring the Python model_validator. Slug regex / commit_sha regex / email validator / UUID4 / ISO-8601 datetime all explicit and documented in the source.

pheno-pydantic-models: setuptools build, requires-python >=3.11, deps pydantic>=2.6 + email-validator>=2.0, dev extras [pytest, pytest-cov]. All 3 models are Pydantic v2 BaseModel subclasses with model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid', frozen=True) so unknown fields are rejected at validation time and instances are immutable values. UUID4 for User.id, EmailStr for emails, AwareDatetime for timestamps (rejects naive datetimes), Field(min_length=1, max_length=80) on display_name. The 'owner must be a member' invariant is enforced by a model_validator(mode='after') on Project. WorklogStatus is a str Enum of the same 6 members as the TS tuple. Module-level constants (COMMIT_SHA_PATTERN, SLUG_PATTERN, DISPLAY_NAME_MAX, DISPLAY_NAME_MIN, PROJECT_NAME_MAX, PROJECT_NAME_MIN) are exported so the two packages' constraint surfaces cannot drift silently.

Test parity: 5 tests on each side, all passing. (a) user_schema_rejects_invalid_email, (b) worklog_entry_schema_accepts_all_six_statuses, (c) worklog_entry_schema_rejects_unknown_status, (d) project_schema_requires_at_least_one_owner_member, (e) schema_types_infer_correctly. The TS suite has a 6th test (user_schema_accepts_well_formed_user) that the task spec describes as part of the 'rejects' trio implicitly — kept it as a baseline so the reject tests are meaningful.

Tripwire pattern: both suites have a final assertion that the WorklogStatus set has exactly 6 members. Mirrors the l3-46 (pheno-errors) tripwire test that breaks compilation if a 6th variant is added. Adding a 7th status value is a breaking change to the wire contract and must be coordinated across both packages.

Install/runtime: TS uses npm install + npx vitest run (verified on node v25.9.0, npm 11.12.1, zod 3.25.76, vitest 1.6.1, typescript 5.9.3). Python uses a venv because the system pip is PEP 668-blocked on this machine; the venv pattern is documented in the README. Verified on python 3.14.5, pydantic 2.13.4, pydantic-core 2.46.4, email-validator 2.3.0, pytest 9.0.3.
